name: iShares Gold Trust (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: IAUon is Ondo's tokenized iShares Gold Trust exposure, a NAV-style ETF tracker for non-U.S. investors rather than a $1 stablecoin.
collateral: Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure referencing iShares Gold Trust (IAU), designed to provide economic exposure to the underlying publicly traded ETF through Ondo GM rather than direct ownership of ETF shares
pegMechanism: NAV-style tokenized ETF tracker rather than a $1 peg; subscriptions, redemptions, and market pricing follow the underlying IAU economic exposure through Ondo Global Markets and eligible investor flows

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ondo Global Markets assets use the Ondo Bridge, which documents LayerZero OFT architecture for GM assets in addition to USDY. Because IAUon is an Ondo GM asset and route accounting depends on that external OFT stack, it is scored as external-lock-mint.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: Native IAUon: MINTER_ROLE enumeration (read 2026-07-20) shows the Ondo GMTokenManager 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c (12,828-byte issuance contract) plus the chain's OndoOFT as the two mint authorities. Ondo Global Markets issues natively on this chain.

Native IAUon: MINTER_ROLE enumeration (read 2026-07-20) shows the Ondo GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 (12,828-byte issuance contract) plus the chain's OndoOFT as the two mint authorities. Ondo Global Markets issues natively on this chain.

IAUon on Solana shares the Ondo program mint authority PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD (no SOL account exists at the address — a program-derived mint authority, read 2026-07-20 via Solana RPC); freeze authority 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK is Ondo's. DefiLlama attributes Solana IAUon supply to Ondo's cross-chain deployment.

IAUon on HyperEVM is minted solely by the OndoOFT contract 0xce61f9246755cc399fd7f37d6b3478590b75aace (sole MINTER_ROLE member, read 2026-07-20): a 6,152-byte LayerZero OApp with endpoint() = HyperEVM LZ V2 endpoint 0x3a73033c0b1407574c76bdbac67f126f6b4a9aa9 and token() = this deployment.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: IAUon resolves to Yes because it is a centrally issued Ondo GM tokenized ETF product with eligibility restrictions and issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer infrastructure.

reserveReview.rationale: Ondo identifies IAUon as economic exposure to iShares Gold Trust and states that each Ondo tokenized stock is fully backed by the underlying security together with cash in transit. Ankura Trust Company independently verifies the existence and amount of underlying securities and reconciles investor liabilities to reserves daily. The current IAU share inventory and cash-in-transit weight are not published in the reviewed durable sources, so they remain an allocation uncertainty rather than unidentified reserve categories.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ondo IAUon product disclosure and Ondo Global Markets backing and transparency documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The aggregate basket is known to contain IAU shares and cash in transit, but their current weights are not published. Because the 100% reserve entry cannot be split between those categories, the full basket remains known-unknown for composition scoring; custodial broker-dealer identities and provider allocation are also undisclosed.

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: Ondo GM Tokens provide economic exposure to the underlying ETF but do not give holders direct rights to hold or receive the underlying ETF shares; eligibility restrictions apply.

mintAuthority.summary: IAUon uses issuer-controlled minting across Ethereum, BSC, HyperEVM, and Solana. The three EVM tokens are BeaconProxy deployments whose shared Ondo beacons are upgradeable through 2-hour owner timelocks; Ethereum direct minters are identified, but the complete BSC/HyperEVM role graphs and Solana mint/program-upgrade authorities are not yet enumerated in this profile.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (Ethereum) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c; Blockscout source: GMTokenManager. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets.

controls.label: OndoOFT (Ethereum) — LayerZero cross-chain minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) = 0x8ffe0da486a4075e7bbb5763fad4732d41f9667c; Blockscout source: OndoOFT. This contract enables LayerZero-based cross-chain mint/burn for IAUon.

controls.label: IAUon deployment-wide beacon-owner timelocks (incomplete)
controls.evidence: Ethereum, BSC, and HyperEVM IAUon tokens resolve through UpgradeableBeacon contracts 0x985462c9..., 0xc046b05a..., and 0x258269e7.... Their owners are distinct TimelockControllers with 7,200-second delays. This records the confirmed upgrade surface without asserting terminal role members or signer thresholds that have not been completed for IAUon; Solana is outside this EVM control.

review.evidence: The prior immutable/no-proxy ruling is superseded. Sourcify and EIP-1967 beacon-slot reads show that the Ethereum, BSC, and HyperEVM IAUon tokens are BeaconProxy deployments using Ondo's shared upgradeable beacons, whose owner timelocks each report a 7,200-second delay. Ethereum direct minters remain identified, but this IAUon profile does not yet enumerate the terminal BSC/HyperEVM timelock roles and signer structures or the Solana Token-2022 mint and GM-program upgrade authorities. Ankura's daily assets-and-liabilities verification remains valid backing evidence, but it does not close these deployment-control gaps.
